sources.plan_role: supplemental migration intent, constraints, systems, success criteria

rules.name: Evidence-first specification
requires: Functional behavior comes from analysis.json.user_stories[] (requirements, source); control_flows[] are supplementary evidence
Technical decisions come from target-architecture.md
Plan data is supplemental and never overrides user_stories or architecture evidence
Unknowns are recorded as evidence gaps instead of assumptions

rules.name: Target architecture is authoritative
requires: Every user story (by spec_id) is referenced by target-architecture.md
SDD plan and tasks reference target-architecture.md
No new target stack, component model, integration strategy, or data architecture is introduced after /architect

rules.name: Requirements are mandatory
requires: Every user story has requirements
Every user story has edge_cases
Spec and tasks preserve spec_id, contract, and source traceability

rules.name: Control flows are first-class requirements
requires: Affected control flows from analysis.json are rendered in spec.json
Affected control flows receive flow/integration test tasks
Flow tests map to related specifications where available

rules.name: Spec/NFR/contracts traceability
requires: Every user story preserves its explicit spec_id in spec.json
Every requirement appears in spec.json
NFRs are derived from target architecture, integration contracts, plan constraints, success criteria, or migration docs
Contracts/ contains integration and behavioral contract artifacts

rules.name: Staged code generation only
requires: Generated code paths stay under an output_dir declared in .migration/<feature>/config.json (or one of components[]'s output_dirs for multi-artifact features)
The code-generation contract records output path(s), templates, and verification commands for every component

rules.name: Test-first implementation
requires: Every user-story slice has a failing test task before implementation
RED observations are recorded before related source writes
Verification evidence is recorded before completion

rules.name: Migration docs are supporting evidence
requires: .migration/docs/ is consulted when present
Docs can strengthen contracts but cannot override analysis.json or target-architecture.md
